title: Glowing gift bag
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='bagGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff5fa2'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c2185b'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='glowGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff7c2'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffd93b'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- handles -->
  <path d='M32 30 Q32 14 44 14 Q50 14 50 20' fill='none' stroke='#ffd93b' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M68 30 Q68 14 56 14 Q50 14 50 20' fill='none' stroke='#fff7c2' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- bag body -->
  <rect x='24' y='30' width='52' height='56' rx='4' fill='url(#bagGrad)'/>
  <!-- lit top edge -->
  <rect x='24' y='30' width='52' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ff9ecb'/>
  <!-- shine stripes -->
  <rect x='32' y='40' width='5' height='38' rx='2.5' fill='#ffb3d6'/>
  <rect x='41' y='40' width='3' height='30' rx='1.5' fill='#ffd0e5'/>
  <!-- gift glow peeking from top -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='33' rx='18' ry='5' fill='url(#glowGrad)'/>
  <!-- star on bag -->
  <path d='M62 58 l3 7 7 1 -5 5 1 7 -6 -4 -6 4 1 -7 -5 -5 7 -1 z' fill='#ffe873'/>
  <path d='M62 62 l2 4 5 1 -4 3 1 5 -4 -3 -4 3 1 -5 -4 -3 5 -1 z' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  <!-- little glow hearts -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='76' r='3' fill='#ffe873'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='80' r='2' fill='#fff7c2'/>
</svg>
